description: This file contains end-to-end tests for the public pages of the ApplicantPortal. It uses Playwright to simulate user interactions and verify page content and navigation flows, focusing on landing page elements, navigation bar links, route fallbacks, and redirection logic for unauthenticated access to protected routes.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite encompassing multiple related test cases.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case with a description and test logic.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertions to verify the state or properties of page elements during tests.
